Helena accepts the command with a curt, decisive nod. There is no room for argument when the calculus has been made clear. She moves instantly to her tactical station and begins inputting the override sequence—a procedure that requires bypassing multiple layers of safety protocols due to Node Three's unstable state.

"Initiating isolation sequence," she reports, her voice regaining some of its rigid control despite the mounting pressure. "This will force a temporary reduction in the EMDF field efficiency and severely stress the primary containment buffer."

The effect is instantaneous and violent. The intense rhythmic thrumming of Jora’s EMDF field falters, the controlled pulse breaking down into a ragged, stuttering vibration. A high-pitched, grinding sound echoes through Command Level One as the localized dampening field momentarily loses its cohesive power.

The holographic projection of Node Three reacts to the power loss. Instead of stabilizing, the Entity responds to the abrupt interruption. The fractal geometry visible in Node Three’s viewport doesn't collapse—it snaps inward, accelerating its integration into the surrounding station architecture like a predatory reflex. It has interpreted the disconnection not as an attack, but as a severing of necessary biological feedback. "It's reacting," Ren whispers, staring at her console, the color draining from her face in stark relief against the red glow of the alerts.

THE NEW CRISIS

The Entity, sensing the loss of its informational pathway, immediately shifts focus from passive assimilation to active structural infiltration. Microscopic distortions flash across Jora's viewport display—fractal lattices are now visibly forming within the *internal* load-bearing conduits leading away from Node Three and into Command Level One itself.
